Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), December volume, plate for the 27th, filed by Commons under Category:Theodorus Graptus - Theodore the Branded, brother of Theophanes, the confessor who died in prison under the iconoclast Theophilus. That is the folder's Theodore, brother of Theophanes, dead before the 842 restoration of the icons; 27 December is his day, and the plate is not one of the many other Theodores in the series.
